title: LockedSpec
description: Output of the Planning/Requirements stage. Product type, stack, and feature scope, locked for this build cycle.

version.description: Spec version. Incremented on every re-plan/delta cycle, never mutated in place.

features.description: Plain-language feature list, e.g. 'user signup/login', 'create/edit/delete tasks'.

constraints.description: Optional non-functional constraints (e.g. 'must run on 8GB RAM', 'no external API calls').
